won.source: Won the promotion's own first Heavyweight Championship tournament final over Terry Storm by pinfall (dragon suplex) at 32:45.

title: legends-1998-worcester-county
label: Carlos Manticore

won.source: Won the promotion's own first Worcester County Championship three-way match, the deciding fall ending in a near-simultaneous double-down that the ring announcer credited to Manticore.

note: The deciding fall's own finish (both men down for a full ten count after a simultaneous double cross-body) was ambiguous in the broadcast's own description; the ring announcer named Manticore champion regardless.
